places_hint: the files that matter when something breaks or moves to another server
bk.offsite_title: Mr. Backup: local snapshot and Kopia offsite
bk.local_title: Mr. Backup: only a local snapshot or dump on this server — gone if the server is gone
bk.none_title: Mr. Backup doesn't back this up
place.unraid_intro: Everything Unraid knows about itself lives in /boot/config.
place.docker_intro: Containers from Unraid's Docker page are described by an XML template on the flash — add the container again from it (Apps → Previous Apps) and it is back with all its settings. Their data lives in appdata.
place.compose_intro: The Compose Manager keeps each stack in its own folder on the flash: the compose file, an override and the .env with the variables. «Indirect» stacks point to a folder elsewhere.
place.vms_intro: Everything that makes a VM — its XML, the UEFI variables (NVRAM) and the TPM state — lives inside libvirt.img, which is mounted at /etc/libvirt while the VM service runs. The virtual disks live in the domains share.
place.vms_more: Details per VM — what you need to move each one →
place.scripts_intro: Every user script is a folder on the flash with its script; the schedules of all of them are in one file.
place.office_intro: The office itself, its runtime data (state, PIN) and the backup engine's settings, logs and database dumps.
loc.flash_config_note: The whole configuration — this is what Unraid's flash backup saves.
loc.super_dat_note: Which disk is parity, disk1, … — without it you must assign the array again by hand.
loc.ssh: SSH host keys and root's keys
loc.ram: Lives in RAM — gone after a restart unless a syslog server or the mirror to flash is set up.
loc.docker_folder: A folder (not docker.img) — rebuilt by pulling the images again.
loc.libvirt_img_note: Mounted at {mounted}: XML, NVRAM and TPM state of all VMs.

vm.nvram_copies.one: plus 1 copy from a VM snapshot

vm.tpm_none: no TPM state folder yet (the VM never ran?)
vm.overlay: This disk is an overlay from a VM snapshot — it only works together with the file(s) below.
vm.move_hint: To move this VM to another server you need all of these files.
vm.tpm_hint: Without the TPM state Windows still starts, but BitLocker asks for its recovery key and Windows Hello PINs are gone.
vm.config_local: XML, NVRAM and TPM state are only backed up locally, not offsite. Mr. Backup can archive them with the dumps (Set up… → VM configuration).
vm.config_none: XML, NVRAM and TPM state aren't backed up at all. Mr. Backup can archive them with the dumps (Set up… → VM configuration).
boot.pool: This server doesn't boot from a USB stick but from the ZFS pool «{pool}» — a {layout} over {devices}, started from the EFI partitions {efi}. Everything Unraid knows about itself is there in /boot/config.
boot.usb: Everything Unraid knows about itself lives on the USB stick {name} in /boot/config.
boot.internal: Everything Unraid knows about itself lives in /boot/config on the internal boot disk {devices}.
boot.other: Everything Unraid knows about itself lives in /boot/config ({fs}).
boot.restore: Getting it back: install Unraid fresh on a boot medium (Unraid USB Creator or Unraid's own installer), then copy the config folder back — the array, shares, Docker templates, plugins and the license key file come back with it.
boot.degraded: The boot pool {pool} isn't healthy ({state}) — check it on the Main page.
boot.single: The boot pool has only one disk — if it fails, Unraid doesn't start until it's restored.
boot.license_tpm: The license ({file}) is bound to the TPM of this mainboard: on the same mainboard there is nothing to transfer. Only a new mainboard needs a license transfer (Tools → Registration).
boot.license_flash: The license ({file}) is bound to the boot stick's GUID ({guid}): with a new stick, transfer it to the new GUID (Tools → Registration).
boot.license_other: The license ({file}) belongs to a GUID that is neither this stick's nor this TPM's — check it under Tools → Registration.
legend.title: Backup as Mr. Backup does it:
legend.offsite: local snapshot + Kopia, encrypted off the server
legend.local: only a snapshot or dump on this server — gone with the server
